patch_evidence_decision.basis: Section 2.1 describes sinter-emission, zinc-resource and paratungstate-uncertainty corrections. None of the inspected root/producer activities belongs to those named corrections. Matching product UUID, unit and exact functional definitions support the limited inference that the reference/function can be used for these 3.7 proxies. This is an inference, not proof of identical unpatched inventory vectors or downstream results.
patch_evidence_decision.restriction: Do not apply this decision to changed activities, reconstruct unpatched source vectors from the patch, transfer any source LCIA result, or silently rename the requested source version.

limitations: Complete hydraulic-digger excavation service per cubic metre, including machine infrastructure, diesel, lubricating oil and operating emissions. Not machine ownership, operating hours or excavated material mass. No soil-density, productivity or machine-lifetime multiplier; no extra duplicate fuel or machine. Separate caller haulage and disposal remain separate. Both definitions use an old representative machine and year-2000 off-road emissions; they warn against use when this service dominates the study. Require sensitivity or primary data for material contributions.

Source internal supplier shares, final-market logistics and internal uncertainty are replaced rather than reconstructed. Geography, technology, grade/design, allocation, vintage and native biosphere exclusions differ; score effects are unquantified and no inventory or LCIA equivalence is claimed.
